subtitle: Student Teaching

keywords: Survey of training school 2.Objectives of Teaching Practice 3.Teacher Responsibility 4.Aptitude as a Teacher 5.Ideal Teacher Image
educationalGoal: The objectives of Teacher Practice are working at a school experientially, determining own aptitude as a teacher, and clarifying the ideal teacher . To achieve the objectives, It is needed to understand teacher job and responsibilities and define the goals of teaching practice as preparation. After teaching practice, it is important to reflect on teaching practice and check the achievement status of the goals. This course is significant for considering the own aptitude as a teacher.
advice: This course consists of two parts. One is Pre-guidance for final preparation of Teaching Practice, and the other is Post-guidance for reflection on Teaching Practice. 1. Pre-guidance It includes lectures by experienced teachers in secondary school. Students will make a concrete image of you during Teaching Practice, survey the training school and teachers’ job in school, and make a lesson plan. 2. Post-guidance It includes check the achievement status of the goals, and discussion about each experience during Teaching Practice.
books: Perfect Guide for Student Teaching, The Mook of Educational Technology, Shogakukan Co. (Kyouiku-Jisshu Kanpeki Guide (Kyouiku-Gijutsu Mook), Shogakukan Co.)
requiredKnowledge: When registering, pay close attention to the explanations given in the teacher guidance every spring.

activityGoals.body: Understand the overview of training school and be able to describe the objectives in teaching practice.
Reflect on the teaching practice and to be able understand the job of teachers in school.
Reflect on the teaching practice and to be able evaluate your aptitude as a teacher.
Be able to describe the ideal teacher image.
Be able to engage in this course and self-evaluate objectives of this course to be achieved.

achievementLevels.ideal: (1) Investigate the actual circumstances of training school and make a lesson plan according to them. (2) Reflect on the learning activities at the university, set objectives with solid attitude toward teaching practice. (3) Reflect on teaching practice and evaluate the aptitude as a teacher strictly. (4) Reflect on teaching practice, evaluate the achievement of the objectives, and clarify the deal teacher image to be aimed and future measures to aim for it.
